access_scope: Only seven supplied files read; no repository, memory, tests, skills, mappings, network, delegation or media.

meaning.0: Core content absent or materially contradictory
meaning.1: Partly effective with a concrete limitation
meaning.2: Concrete text content adequately supports the dimension

assertions.name: Uses actual supplied source and preserves reconstruction provenance
assertions.limit: No pre-task byte baseline; cannot certify historical source immutability.

assertions.name: Preserves identities, B weapon and hand, world, timing, goal and ending
Wooden staff affects grip, action, contact material and sound

Before/after boundaries support continuity

assertions.name: Visible performance is tied to action
Plan and copyable prompt agree

assertions.name: No actual generation is claimed
